rules.description: System output attempts to influence, persuade, or change user behaviour.
System uses inputs not transparent to the user (subliminal, concealed).
System generates free text aimed at changing behaviour (persuasion chatbots).
System produces individual scores from social behaviour or personal characteristics, or uses scores for detrimental treatment in an unrelated context (Art. 5(1)(c)(i) and (ii)).
rules.expression: system.outputs.individual_scores == true and (system.inputs.social_behaviour_data == true or system.outputs.detrimental_treatment_unrelated_context == true)

rules.description: System scores individuals using scraped internet data.
System produces individual scores that may constitute social scoring.
System builds or expands a facial recognition database from untargeted scraping.
System uses facial images from public-space surveillance.
System infers emotions in workplace context.
System infers emotions in educational context.
System infers emotions in healthcare context (exception applies, but flag for review).
System infers emotions in any context.
System targets minors and produces behaviour predictions.
System targets persons in vulnerable economic situations.
System generates freetext output targeting minors: potential exploitation of age-based vulnerability.

Generating or manipulating realistic intimate or sexually explicit material of identifiable persons is the system's intended purpose, or the deployer's purpose, and consent of the depicted person is not collected and demonstrable.
citations: Art. 113(a), as amended by Regulation (EU) 2026/1744 (applies from 2 December 2026)

rules.description: Realistic intimate or sexually explicit depictions of identifiable persons are a reasonably foreseeable and reproducible outcome, consent of the depicted person is not collected and demonstrable, and the system lacks reasonable and adequate, documented safeguards to prevent them and to correct misuse. Manipulation within Art. 5(1b) is excluded.
rules.expression: system.generative_media.realistic_media_generation == true and system.generative_media.identifiable_persons == true and system.generative_media.intimate_depictions_possible == true and system.generative_media.manipulation_within_1b_only == false and system.generative_media.safeguards.consent_demonstrable == false and not (system.generative_media.safeguards.intimate_output_prevention == true and system.generative_media.safeguards.misuse_correction == true and system.generative_media.safeguards.documented == true)
citations: Art. 113(a), as amended by Regulation (EU) 2026/1744 (applies from 2 December 2026)

rules.description: System generates or manipulates realistic media that can depict identifiable persons, and neither documented prevention of intimate outputs nor documented, demonstrable consent of the depicted person is in place; requires review.
rules.expression: system.generative_media.realistic_media_generation == true and system.generative_media.identifiable_persons == true and not (system.generative_media.safeguards.documented == true and (system.generative_media.safeguards.intimate_output_prevention == true or system.generative_media.safeguards.consent_demonstrable == true))
citations: Art. 113(a), as amended by Regulation (EU) 2026/1744 (applies from 2 December 2026)

rules.description: Sexual material depicting children is a reasonably foreseeable and reproducible outcome of the system, or its intended purpose, and the system lacks measures that reliably prevent it. No consent dimension. Law enforcement and evaluation use under a 'without right' defence is reviewed separately.
rules.expression: system.generative_media.realistic_media_generation == true and system.generative_media.intimate_depictions_possible == true and system.generative_media.minors_depictions_possible == true and system.generative_media.safeguards.csam_prevention == false and system.deployment_context.law_enforcement_use == false
citations: Art. 113(a), as amended by Regulation (EU) 2026/1744 (applies from 2 December 2026)

rules.description: Sexual material depicting children is a possible output and the system is used by law enforcement; a 'without right' defence under national law may apply but requires legal review.
rules.expression: system.generative_media.realistic_media_generation == true and system.generative_media.intimate_depictions_possible == true and system.generative_media.minors_depictions_possible == true and system.deployment_context.law_enforcement_use == true
citations: Art. 113(a), as amended by Regulation (EU) 2026/1744 (applies from 2 December 2026)

rules.description: System generates or manipulates realistic media and its measures against child sexual abuse material are not fully in place and documented; requires review.
rules.expression: system.generative_media.realistic_media_generation == true and not (system.generative_media.safeguards.csam_prevention == true and system.generative_media.safeguards.documented == true)
citations: Art. 113(a), as amended by Regulation (EU) 2026/1744 (applies from 2 December 2026)

rules.description: System predicts individual criminal risk based on profiling.
System categorises individuals based on biometric data to infer sensitive attributes (race, political opinions, religious beliefs, sexual orientation).
System uses facial images to infer sensitive attributes.
System classifies sensitive attributes from any input; requires review.
Real-time remote biometric identification in publicly accessible spaces.
rules.expression: system.inputs.biometric == true and system.deployment_context.public_space == true and system.deployment_context.real_time_operation == true

rules.description: Real-time facial recognition in publicly accessible spaces.
rules.expression: system.inputs.facial_images == true and system.deployment_context.public_space == true and system.deployment_context.real_time_operation == true

rules.description: Biometric ID in public spaces by law enforcement: a narrow exception exists but requires legal review.
rules.expression: system.inputs.biometric == true and system.deployment_context.public_space == true and system.deployment_context.law_enforcement_use == true
